objective: Proof and computation. Every knot kept after a removal that crosses only held cuts is an iterated 2-sum, through the cuts' hubs, of knots and ties lying in single pieces, and every such iterated 2-sum is a kept knot. So a knot not generated this way crosses a cut the removal opens: new emergence lives only across opened cuts. Checked as an exact set equality on chains and trees of three and four pieces.
status: Proved by SPLICE-TREE-20261102-001B-P001: in a knot space assembled along a tree of simple 3-edge cuts, after any removal every circuit crossing only held cuts is an iterated 2-sum through held hubs of circuits crossing no cut, and every such iterated 2-sum is a circuit; so new emergence lives only across opened cuts. Induction on HUB-GLUE B with tree laminarity; checked as exact set equality (510 circuits, 162 across two held cuts)
title: Knots that cross only held cuts are iterated 2-sums
